category_edits.rationale: Test a small reduction in tied normalized item-embedding radius from 0.8 to 0.75 across all four datasets. Preserve width, tying, features, backbone, scoring, loss and optimizer. The generated predictor imports this model class, so training and inference use the same radius without checkpoint shape changes.

change_summary: Reduce only the tied normalized embedding radius multiplier to 0.75 for all four category models, consistently in training and inference.
